subject: Discovery follow-up & VP/CTO intro — scheduling exec alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmehealth.com>, John Lee <john.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps after discovery call

Hi Sarah / John —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (very high level):
- Primary workload: patient-facing summarization and triage for care teams; sensitivity around PHI and retention policies
- Current pain: high token cost and unpredictable latency at peak times, and need for private deployment in our VPC for audits
- Success criteria: sub-200ms 95th pct latency for short queries, <30% reduction in per-token cost vs current vendor, and SOC 2 evidence for procurement

Immediate next steps we discussed:
1) Exec alignment — VP of Engineering / CTO intro to unblock procurement and SRE questions
2) Technical deep dive / demo with our infra team to validate latency and KMS integrations
3) Share a mutual action plan and product one-pager (attached)

Are you available for a 30–45 minute executive alignment call next week so we can introduce John (CTO) to our VP-level contacts and outline procurement milestones? Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed 10/06 between 10:00–11:00
- Thu 10/07 between 14:00–15:30
- Fri 10/08 between 09:00–11:00

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.com/marissa/30min

I've attached a short one-pager and our suggested mutual action plan to make scheduling and procurement easier.

Thanks — happy to loop in Marcus (our infra lead) and Jonas (solutions lead) on the follow-up demos.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
